recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If the work group wants the resolution's positiveInt wording enforced exactly, make that follow-up in the FHIR Extension Pack by changing questionnaire-sliderStepValue value[x] or adding an equivalent constraint there.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 Questionnaire issue requesting a slider-step-value extension to express step size for ranged slider answers, with an item-type constraint for integer items and resolution wording that described the value as positiveInt.
initial_application: SVN r14772 / git b8c5990ac5 listed 16114 and added sliderStepValue to the core Questionnaire extensions spreadsheet with context type='integer', value type integer, and the definition about step size for slider-based controls.
additional_context: Core later generated a questionnaire-sliderStepValue StructureDefinition, but dd468d4f17 removed extension definitions from R5 core source. Current core keeps only the OID assignment in source/oids.ini, while /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions contains the active StructureDefinition-questionnaire-sliderStepValue.xml with Questionnaire.item and ElementDefinition contexts, integer contextInvariant, and integer value[x]. Zulip discussion confirms the original need and later use of minValue, maxValue, and sliderStepValue for slider controls.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source was changed because the current core build no longer owns the extension definition; any remaining value-type refinement belongs in HL7/fhir-extensions.

related_jiras.note: Separate FHIR-us-pro retracted issue mentions Item.sliderStepValue as an SDC/PRO advanced rendering need; it does not change the core ownership decision.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 Questionnaire issue asking for a slider-step-value extension with integer-item-only scope and positiveInt wording.

evidence_items.summary: Ana Kostadinovska asked how to specify a step size with minValue/maxValue and Lloyd McKenzie suggested a new international-spec extension.

evidence_items.summary: Questionnaire changes commit lists 16114 and adds sliderStepValue to the Questionnaire extensions spreadsheet with integer context and value type.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was historically applied in core, though the implemented value type was integer rather than the resolution's positiveInt wording.

evidence_items.summary: Core retains the OID assignment for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/questionnaire-sliderStepValue.
evidence_items.learned: The current core checkout preserves canonical identifier metadata but does not define the extension content.

evidence_items.learned: Any remaining definitional correction, including positiveInt enforcement, belongs in the Extension Pack repository rather than core.
